verses.text: Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,

segments.text: Hear this, all ye peoples;
Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,

verses.text: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.

segments.text: Both low and high,
Rich and poor together.

verses.text: My mouth shall speak wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

segments.text: My mouth shall speak wisdom;
And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

verses.text: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

segments.text: I will incline mine ear to a parable:
I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?

segments.text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil,
When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?

verses.text: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

segments.text: They that trust in their wealth,
And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.text: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him

segments.text: None
of them
can by any means redeem his brother,
Nor give to God a ransom for him

verses.text: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever),

segments.text: (For the redemption of their life is costly,
And it faileth for ever),

verses.text: That he should still live alway, That he should not see corruption.

segments.text: That he should still live alway,
That he should not see corruption.

verses.text: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.

segments.text: For he shall see it. Wise men die;
The fool and the brutish alike perish,
And leave their wealth to others.

verses.text: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, And their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.

segments.text: Their inward thought is,
that
their houses
shall continue
for ever,
And
their dwelling-places to all generations;
They call their lands after their own names.

verses.text: But man being in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.

segments.text: But man
being
in honor abideth not:
He is like the beasts that perish.

verses.text: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. [Selah

segments.text: This their way is their folly:
Yet after them men approve their sayings. [Selah

verses.text: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd: And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume, That there be no habitation for it.

segments.text: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol;
Death shall be their shepherd:
And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning;
And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume,
That there be no habitation for it.

verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. [Selah

segments.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol;
For he will receive me. [Selah

verses.text: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased:

segments.text: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich,
When the glory of his house is increased:

verses.text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.

segments.text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away;
His glory shall not descend after him.

verses.text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul (And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself),

segments.text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul
(And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself),

verses.text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light.

segments.text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers;
They shall never see the light.

verses.text: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not, Is like the beasts that perish.

segments.text: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not,

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
